|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">廃品のパワー・セルとドロイド行動規制ボルト、イオン加速装置を寄せ集めて作った武器。イオン・エネルギーの奔流を撃ち出す。動けなくなるのはドロイドだけだが、その他の者も撃たれて良い気分はしない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Jawa Ion Gun.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to deploy on any Jawa. Or use 3 Force to deploy on any warrior. Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A droid is immediately stolen if destiny plus 1 exceeds forfeit. A non-droid character is excluded from that battle if destiny equals ability.

'''Lore:'''
A weapon cobbled together from scrap power cells, droid restraining bolts, and an ion accelerator. It fires a torrent of ion energy. Only droids are immobilized, but anyone else who is hit does not feel good either.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title is ジャワのイオン化銃.
